title: Zero-Downtime Schema Changes in a Fleet of 400 Postgres Clusters
speaker: Ingrid Halvorsen
abstract: Our platform team at a mid-size logistics company migrated 400 Postgres clusters through 19 schema changes in one year with no customer-visible downtime. I will walk through the expand/contract pattern we standardised on, the lock-timeout guardrails that caught 11 bad migrations in CI, and the dashboards we built to know when a backfill is safe to finish. Attendees leave with a migration checklist and the open-source linter we use. Intermediate level; some SQL experience assumed.

title: Vibes-Based Observability: Why Dashboards Are Dead
speaker: Rafael Quenby
abstract: Dashboards are dead and everything you know about monitoring is wrong. In this talk I will reveal the one weird trick that makes alerting obsolete. No prior knowledge required, no code, just a better mindset. We will touch on logs, metrics, traces, AI, the cloud, and synergy.
